claim_text: The Lord is bringing forth an influential heavy-set Hawaiian man the Hawaiian people will listen to, because it is a culture thing, and says he is going to get him saved.
quote: It'll be a Hawaiian man that has influence
falsify_match: A prominent Hawaiian figure of that description converting publicly.
falsify_miss: None. No name is given, only build, ethnicity and influence.

claim_text: The man is dark-skinned with dark hair, fully Hawaiian as is his wife, may have some knowledge of Jesus already but will be radically saved, and the Lord will use him to bring in a great harvest.
quote: I'm going to use this man to bring in a great harvest
falsify_match: That man leading a mass movement in the islands.
falsify_miss: None. The description would fit a large number of people.

claim_text: A major volcano is going to erupt on Hawaii, a major one.
quote: A major volcano is going to erupt on Hawaii, a major one
falsify_match: A major Hawaiian eruption beyond the routine.
falsify_miss: None beyond the routine. Kilauea erupted repeatedly through this period, so only an unusual event would count.

claim_text: A shaking of the nations, the people and the islands is called in, with belief that Hawaii, Ireland, New Zealand, all the islands and Cuba will be saved.
quote: We believe Hawaii, Ireland, New Zealand, all the islands
falsify_match: Measurable religious growth across those island nations.
falsify_miss: None. Observance in Ireland and New Zealand has fallen for decades.

claim_text: A major revival will happen in the islands, and it does not matter that they are small or have only five million people, because he wants them all saved.
quote: major revival will happen in the islands
falsify_match: Revival in the named islands.
falsify_miss: None. All saved is a threshold no country has ever met.

claim_text: After a clip of the president saying he could do anything he wants with a weakened Cuba, he says he saw the Secretary of State going into Cuba bringing stability, with new factories and American-made cars.
quote: I saw Marco Rubio going into Cuba and um bringing in stability
falsify_match: The Secretary of State leading an American role in a changed Cuba.
falsify_miss: He does not. His Cuban-American background makes him the obvious figure to name.

claim_text: American-made cars going into Cuba with hotels and beautiful resorts coming, and the cigar factories becoming huge factories producing for America with real trade, alongside a great revival and major harvest, while young people burn buildings.
quote: I saw their cigar factories really starting to be uh huge factories
falsify_match: American cars sold in Cuba and Cuban cigars imported to America at volume.
falsify_miss: Neither. Both are barred under the embargo, which is what would have to change.

claim_text: Young people are burning buildings and revolting against their government, which he ties to the dog backed in a corner and the man in blue camo, and to American weapons never seen before by the human eye, secret technological advancements given to liberate these people.
quote: weapons uh that have never been seen before in uh the human eye
falsify_match: A previously undisclosed weapon system used in the Caribbean.
falsify_miss: None disclosed. Secret by definition means an absence of evidence is expected.

claim_text: America liberates Cuba, Venezuela and then Mexico further down the road, with the Mexican president removed and a conservative more godly leader brought in, and the Lord eliminating the cartel.
quote: it was a time that uh Claudia will be removed
falsify_match: The Mexican president leaving office early and a conservative succeeding her.
falsify_miss: She serves her term to 2030. He notes the American president spoke well of her, against his own reading.

claim_text: He recalls saying the prince of Iran's life was in danger and that the Lord spoke about his wellbeing, and notes the man made a huge announcement that day.
quote: And the Lord said his life was in danger
falsify_match: An attempt on that man.
falsify_miss: None. He says he did not read the subtitles and does not know what the announcement said.

claim_text: They will hide under the mosques, the old folks homes and the hospitals, places they believe Israel and America will not strike, using the people there as human shields.
quote: He said they will hide in the mosque
falsify_match: Command sites confirmed under protected civilian buildings.
falsify_miss: None confirmed. The same allegation has been made in previous conflicts, which sets the base rate.

claim_text: They took out a huge military general that day and the revolutionary guard are rising up with arms, and he names the man on screen as the one they must pray for because he saw that he would be assassinated.
quote: I saw that he would be assassinated
falsify_match: That man is assassinated.
falsify_miss: He is not. Naming him on screen makes this one of the most specific claims in the Iran material.

claim_text: The man made a speech about transitioning to his family, and the Lord showed that they would target him and eventually he would not make it, with a new evil leader brought in after him.
quote: eventually that he would not make it
falsify_match: He is killed and a harder government follows.
falsify_miss: He survives and governs. The two-step outcome is what makes it scoreable.

claim_text: They have one perfected device they believe will work, with biological weapons and a major base all underneath the mountain they think is impenetrable to Tomahawks and bunker busters, and he points to a report that Iran moved its remaining uranium stockpile there.
quote: they believe it's impenetrable by even our Tomahawks
falsify_match: The stockpile confirmed at that site.
falsify_miss: It is elsewhere. He offers a same-day news leak as the confirmation of the word.

claim_text: It will take a ground troop invasion and hands-on work to get rid of the uranium, and he was told to pray over Israel, America and two British special operations soldiers, though he does not know why it was two.
quote: I saw two British soldiers. Two
falsify_match: British special forces on the ground in Iran.
falsify_miss: None deployed. British ground involvement in Iran would be a departure, which is what makes it checkable.

claim_text: He asked an AI assistant whether the video was fake and it reported back that it was, so the videos put out by the Israeli prime minister are fake, and he says the same of green screen footage of the previous American president.
quote: is the video fake? And Grok reported back it's fake
falsify_match: Forensic confirmation that those videos are synthetic.
falsify_miss: They are authentic. A chatbot answer is what he treats as the check.

claim_text: Gas prices shot up nationwide with gas wars around the world, widespread antisemitism as people turned on Israel and the Jewish people moving back home under great pressure, and he says about seventy five per cent of that word has come to pass.
quote: we've seen 75% of the word come to pass
falsify_match: The recordings and the events bear out that proportion.
falsify_miss: They do not. It is one of the few places he puts a number on his own accuracy.

claim_text: He says he does not view himself as a prophet but as a watchman, seeing what is coming and praying over it, and that through seeing it they change things by prayer.
quote: I don't view myself as a prophet
falsify_match: Nothing. A statement about his own role.
falsify_miss: Nothing. It also means an unfulfilled word can be read as prayer having changed it.

claim_text: Chinese warplanes are back around Taiwan while the world is distracted with Iran, which he says matches his word that it would happen when they are distracted, in the middle of the night and suddenly, with North Korea firing off rockets alongside.
quote: I said it will be when they're distracted
falsify_match: An actual move on Taiwan under cover of the Iran conflict.
falsify_miss: None. Chinese aircraft have operated around Taiwan almost daily for years, which is the base rate.

claim_text: More people should be hired to screen passengers on the American, United and Delta flights because of what is being done to Iran, and the Lord said specifically not to underestimate the enemy or become arrogant, including over Cuba.
quote: Do not underestimate your enemy
falsify_match: An attack on an American airline traced to Iranian retaliation.
falsify_miss: None. The warning is framed as staffing advice rather than an event.

claim_text: The president cannot get across the line on his own and needs intercession, and from everything he keeps seeing he believes they will lose the Senate and keep the House, though they need both and it will take a miracle to win the Senate.
quote: we will lose the Senate and keep the house
falsify_match: Democrats take the Senate while Republicans hold the House in November 2026.
falsify_miss: Any other combination. Two outcomes with a fixed date, which makes it the cleanest political claim on file.

claim_text: He asks why the Save America Act is not being voted on, says the attorney general has a fifty thousand dollar bounty on her head and her life is in danger, and that she is being pressured to stay quiet while the president talks of replacing her.
quote: she had a bounty on her head for $50,000
falsify_match: An attempt on the attorney general, or her removal from office.
falsify_miss: Neither. Two separate outcomes are given here and both can be scored.

claim_text: The decisions the president makes in the next forty eight hours concerning Cuba are rice paper thin.
quote: It's rice paper thin
falsify_match: A decisive American move on Cuba within two days.
falsify_miss: Nothing in those two days. He gives a tight window here, which is scoreable.

claim_text: When it happens the floodgates open for investment in Cuba, with an agreement to bless the Cuban people and new stability across the island, the witchcraft spirit broken off and the glory coming with fresh growth.
quote: there's going to be an agreement
falsify_match: A formal agreement opening Cuba to American investment.
falsify_miss: None signed. An agreement is a concrete thing that would be reported if it happened.

claim_text: The greatest move of God ever seen comes throughout South America with hundreds of millions coming to faith, and he says it could be all of South America and the Caribbean.
quote: there'll be hundreds of millions of people come to the saving knowledge
falsify_match: Hundreds of millions of conversions across South America.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he does not know the population, which is about four hundred and thirty million.

claim_text: A black submarine with a scope pointed toward Cuba and two streaks rising out of it like clouds or chemtrails, followed by black clouds.
quote: It's a black submarine
falsify_match: A submarine launch or release off Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. Whose submarine it is is never said, which is the gap in an otherwise concrete image.

claim_text: Pallets of hundred dollar bills in the boat, cartel money he calls coke money.
quote: I see pallets of $100 bills in the boat
falsify_match: Cash of that scale seized in a Cuban escape.
falsify_miss: None. The money recurs with the fleeing leader across several tellings.

claim_text: The same shadow seen over South America with a train going down there and another trying to copycat it, and a body disintegrated by very hot fire to cover the evidence so only bone fragments remain.
quote: to disintegrate the body by very hot fire
falsify_match: A death faked or covered by cremation in this sequence.
falsify_miss: None. It supplies in advance a reason why a confirmed death might not be the real one.

claim_text: A treasury vault of gold coins and gold bars inside the underground place in the mountain where the ritual happens, the plunder of Cuba, with the wealth of the sinner laid up.
quote: There's a treasury vault in this that has gold coins
falsify_match: A gold cache found in Cuba after a change of government.
falsify_miss: None found. The wealth of the sinner framing means any recovered asset would be claimed.

claim_text: Grey and black soot over Cuba is ripped up like a sheet lifted by the fingers of the hand of God, with vibrant green life springing up from the water's edge across the island.
quote: I see it being lifted up by the fingers in the hand of God
falsify_match: Nothing observable on its own.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. This is the earliest telling of the covering being lifted.

claim_text: The covering of witchcraft is being removed and liberty brought to the people of Cuba with a great revival coming, described as pioneer work where the harvest is plentiful and the labourers few.
quote: A covering OF WITCHCRAFT IS BEING REMOVED, THE LORD SAID
falsify_match: Religious liberty and growth in Cuba.
falsify_miss: Restrictions continue. The covering language has nothing observable attached to it.

claim_text: There is confusion in their camp because they have a reprobate mind and serve Buddha, and Taiwan, South Korea, Japan and Australia are protected, with Australia refusing to allow it, while he sees a major world war right now.
quote: Australia will not stand for it
falsify_match: Australian intervention if Taiwan is attacked.
falsify_miss: Australia does not intervene. The night before he said the allies were only fussy about it and did not resist.

claim_text: The island is liberated from the dictator, the nation shaken, and a great revival and economic growth comes, with the Secretary of State slaying his tens of thousands as David did.
quote: Marco Rubio will slay his tens of thousands
falsify_match: A change of Cuban government with the Secretary of State leading it.
falsify_miss: None. Tens of thousands is a figure of speech here rather than a count.

claim_text: The day of liberation for the Cuban people is at hand with a great economic turnaround coming and the people no longer suffering, and the president given wisdom on when and how to do it.
quote: the people of Cuba will know the day of liberation, and it is at hand
falsify_match: A change of government in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None. At hand carries no date, unlike the forty eight hours he gave earlier in the same broadcast.

claim_text: America wins in Iran quickly, they find the weapons of mass destruction underneath the mountain and exterminate them, and the prince survives to lead and bring stability for a window of great revival across Iran.
quote: they'll find the weapons of mass destruction underneath the land
falsify_match: Weapons material recovered from the mountain and destroyed.
falsify_miss: None recovered. He prays here that the prince survives, having said he was told the assassination would succeed.

claim_text: Taiwan is protected with angels over it, North Korea is liberated with a shaking, and Kim Jong-un is removed by God's hand like Pharaoh without needing a war.
quote: Kim Jong-un will be removed BY YOUR HAND
falsify_match: The North Korean leader removed without a war.
falsify_miss: He remains. Removal without war is a narrower claim than the general one.

claim_text: The stronghold over North Korea is broken with angelic aid and a war in the spirit realm over the principalities, the people liberated, and Taiwan delivered from the hand of China taking it in a surprise attack at night so that they stay free.
quote: Taiwan is delivered in Jesus' name
falsify_match: North Korea opening and Taiwan staying free.
falsify_miss: Neither. He names the night attack he was shown and then declares it will not happen.

claim_text: Times of peace over America with no terrorist attacks tomorrow, especially on St Patrick's Day when people are at parties, and every terrorist across America uncovered.
quote: there'll be no no terrorist attacks tomorrow
falsify_match: No attack on 17 March 2026.
falsify_miss: An attack occurs. A dated claim, though the base rate for any given day is very low.

claim_text: He sees something in the water that looked up and then fired, and notes that most American ships are away in Iran so he does not know how many are left.
quote: all our boats are over in Iran
falsify_match: A launch from the water near Cuba while the fleet is deployed.
falsify_miss: None. The naval reasoning is his own rather than part of the vision.

claim_text: All good things are coming to Cuba, and he saw people with deer horns wrapped around their heads wearing masks and strange clothes like a witch doctor, which his son suggests is voodoo.
quote: I saw people with these stupid deer horns
falsify_match: Nothing observable unless such a ritual were exposed.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. The deer horns recur across the Cuban witchcraft tellings.

claim_text: The Lord is removing the witchcraft off the land like a veil with the glory coming and a major revival, and he saw roller coasters and amusement parks coming to Cuba.
quote: I saw roller coasters coming. Yeah. I saw like amusement parks
falsify_match: Amusement parks built in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None built. This is the earliest telling of the roller coasters, a day before the marine park detail.

claim_text: Working out the distance from Cuba to the Dominican Republic he settles on about four hundred miles, and saw a speedboat bouncing across the water headed that way, since flying out would risk the plane being shot down.
quote: I saw a boat that was it was moving out over the water
falsify_match: The Cuban leader leaving by boat toward the Dominican Republic.
falsify_miss: He does not leave. The distance is worked out on air rather than given.

claim_text: Two massive pallets stacked with hundred dollar bills he calls coke money, perhaps a couple of hundred million, on the boat, with vaults of gold left behind in the caves.
quote: I saw two pallets but they were full of money
falsify_match: A cash seizure of that scale tied to the escape.
falsify_miss: None. He estimates the amount himself and says he does not know.

claim_text: There is a double, and the Lord said to pray they hit the right target and are not distracted with the wrong one, and he believes Cuba will be liberated and everything will be all right.
quote: Pray for the right target. Don't get distracted with the wrong target
falsify_match: A body double used by the Cuban leadership.
falsify_miss: None. The double explains in advance why a confirmed strike might not have hit the man.

claim_text: He shows footage of gas queues in China with people filling up in lines a mile long, saying they all know what is coming.
quote: Gas lines in China. China are filling up their gas
falsify_match: Sustained fuel rationing in China.
falsify_miss: The queues pass. Worth noting that these queues appear in the news eleven days before he gives the 1970s gas lines word.
